statements.impact_statement: linux-libc-dev is present only in the disposable Node Agent Dapper builder as user-space API headers required by libc6-dev for GCC and Go race tests. The builder contains no Linux kernel image or module package and is never shipped or run as the product. The independently scanned Node Agent binary and runtime image report zero Critical or High findings.
